annotations.text:
Three directions for the Accounstone refresh.

All three keep the real tokens: navy #1e3a5f, gold #c9a876, burnt orange #b84408, paper #faf8f3, Georgia display face.

All three drop the stock-photo hero carousel — that is the single biggest thing dragging the current site down. Pick a direction and I will build it into the live site.

A — DRAWN

Leans all the way into the hand-drawn line illustrations, which are already the site's best and most distinctive asset. Paper ground, gold hairlines, a lot of air. Editorial and calm.

Tradeoff: quietest of the three. If you want the site to feel louder or more 'startup', this is not it.

B — LEDGER

The page is built like an accounting document: a ruled 44px baseline everything sits on, tabular figures, hairline rules, the boundary stated as a table. Most distinctive of the three — nobody else in this category looks like this.

Tradeoff: the strictest. It demands discipline on every future page, and the ruled ground needs care on mobile.

C — WARM MODERN

Closest to the current site and the lowest-risk change: one deep navy panel with real depth instead of a stock photo, soft cards, gold as a proper accent.

Tradeoff: the most conventional. It will read as 'a good modern site' rather than as specifically yours.

The hero panel here contains an ILLUSTRATIVE activity card — real numbers would need to come from you, or it comes out.
